diff --git a/client.py b/client.py
index 94f2650..b3d74f3 100644
--- a/client.py
+++ b/client.py
@@ -1,2 +1,6 @@
 def save(transport, display_name):
     return transport.put("/settings", {"display_name": display_name})
+
+
+def clear_name(transport):
+    return transport.put("/settings", {"display_name": None})
diff --git a/tests/test_client.py b/tests/test_client.py
index 0f4b422..bc5b0a3 100644
--- a/tests/test_client.py
+++ b/tests/test_client.py
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 import unittest
 
-from client import save
+from client import save, clear_name
 
 class MemoryTransport:
     def __init__(self):
@@ -21,3 +21,8 @@ class ClientTests(unittest.TestCase):
         transport = MemoryTransport()
         save(transport, "")
         self.assertEqual(transport.request, ("/settings", {"display_name": ""}))
+
+    def test_clear_name(self):
+        transport = MemoryTransport()
+        self.assertEqual(clear_name(transport), {"ok": True})
+        self.assertEqual(transport.request, ("/settings", {"display_name": None}))
